english.notes:
(i) MoPI notes: this offence may be MoPI Group 2 or 3; manual review is required to consider intent and risk case-by-case.
(ii) In accordance with section 76(1) of the London Government Act 1963, the "metropolitan police district shall consist of Greater London, excluding the city of London, the Inner Temple and the Middle Temple".
